culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Takahiko Kamiyu. Two days ago, while Kamiya is hiring Kogoro, he acquired the prop needed to use as evidence to frame Kumi Fujieda for murdering her husband. Then he invited Genseki Ishiba and Sachiko Kafuka to arrive on the following day, which led the two to meet Kogoro, the house sitter Kamiya hired. After inviting the two, he murdered the novelist, hid the body, and cast suspicion on himself with a fake anonymous tip. Kamiya did those to manipulate Kogoro into believing that he is innocent.

summary.en: Takahiko Kamiyu, a literary critic, entrusted Kogoro with the responsibility of looking after the house and taking care of his anxious cat for three days while he visited the countryside.
